title: Leo: what you need
old_caption: Leo, you need someone who cheers loudly for you, and you shine brightest when you cheer even louder back. Being celebrated feels good. Celebrating them feels just as good.

title: Leo: try this week
old_caption:
Leo, your generosity shines when it's tuned to them. This week, plan a date around what they love, even if it's mini golf.
Their favorite, not yours. That's how they'll know you really see them.

title: Libra: the blind spot
old_caption: Libra, when you say "whatever you want," do you mean it? Your opinion helps a relationship feel balanced. It's okay to say you'd honestly like tacos.

title: Libra: what you need
old_caption: Libra, what you need is someone who meets you halfway and doesn't keep a tally. Love isn't a scoreboard. It's two people walking toward each other.

title: Libra: try this week
old_caption:
Libra, saying no can feel like the sky might fall. This week, try one honest, kind no.
You'll find the stars still in place and you, still loved. A gentle no can be lovely.

title: Pisces: the blind spot
old_caption: Pisces, it's easy to fall for who someone could become. Try dating who they are today. The real person standing in front of you, coffee in hand, is worth seeing clearly.

title: Pisces: what you need
old_caption:
Pisces, you deserve someone gentle with your heart who still helps you keep your feet on the ground.
Tenderness and steadiness can live in the same person. Look for both.

title: Pisces: try this week
old_caption: Pisces, you give so much that your battery runs low. This week, set your boundary before you're exhausted. Being kind to them and kind to yourself can happen at the same time.

title: Sagittarius: the blind spot
old_caption: Sagittarius, when things start getting serious, do you feel the urge to grab your bag? That restless feeling is normal. Staying put and letting it deepen can be the adventure.

title: Sagittarius: what you need
old_caption: Sagittarius, you need someone who lets you roam and keeps the porch light on for when you come home. You don't have to pick between freedom and belonging.
